context: M30 o3. Seoul Star Imports. The deed on the counter. Mrs. Baek with a fountain pen.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Mr. Varelas. You sold us the building in July. Today you visit as a guest.

lines.speaker: char.mi_sook_baek
lines.text: August. You said August. It's August. Sign or don't.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Sold. To the optimists. Now the only landlord you fear is you.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Then we stay tenants. Optimistic tenants.

lines.speaker: char.mi_sook_baek
lines.text: Go see your hotel, Mr. Varelas. Bring cookies. Old people like cookies.
